messages:
ana: quick heads-up, ran a container hardening pass on staging base-image today. CIS scan + provenance checks surfaced a few concerns.

 tom: please list the top ones so we can triage.

 ana: short list: 1) /tmp in image has world-writable dir 2) libssl at 1.1.1 flagged (CVE backlog) 3) missing cosign signature metadata on some tags 4) registry events not appearing in our audit pipeline (pull/create events absent).

 rachel: missing signatures is bad for deploy gating. do we know whether signing step skipped or KMS refused?

 ana: looks like the CI principal lost kms.cryptoSign on the cosign key after an RBAC tightening change last week. the bake still runs but cosign fails silently and pipeline currently continues.

 sam: who made the RBAC change? @kevin?

 kevin: that was me. I scoped down the builder principal to reduce blast radius and removed broad Sign perms. I thought the dedicated signer service would perform signing, but the bake job still calls cosign directly. happy to add a narrowly scoped kms:sign binding for the cosign key.

 tom: do that, and add a hard fail in the bake job if cosign verify fails. we need provenance enforced.

 rachel: simple verify snippet suggestion: 

```
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/prod/.../cryptoKeys/cosign-key $IMAGE
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "unsigned image"; exit 1; fi
```

 ana: will add. next: audit pipeline - our auditd sidecar is only streaming kubelet events; containerd pull events are disabled in current config. security wants pulls for timeline reconstruction.

 sam: we can enable containerd event forwarding and add an image-pull filter so we don't flood the shipper. minimal config: 

```
containerd:
  enabled: true
  include: ["pull","create"]
output:
  url: https://audit-shipper.internal/ingest
filters:
  - event: pull
    fields: [image,registry,tag,node]
```

 kevin: test in staging first. if the shipper spikes we'll add rate limits and a sampling rule for retries.

 rachel: about libssl, we should rebuild base-image to pick distro update. that also gives us a chance to strip /tmp perms and re-run signing.

 tom: plan proposal: 1) quick RBAC patch to restore scoped kms Sign to CI principal + enforce cosign verify in bake, 2) toggle containerd forwarding in staging with the image-pull filter, 3) schedule base-image rebuild this week and do canary deploys.

 kevin: I'll open the RBAC PR and include an expiring justification tag. Also will add rollback steps in the PR description (how to remove the binding).

 ana: for rollback, add these steps in runbook: 1) remove kms binding via gcloud iam remove-iam-policy-binding, 2) tag affected images as quarantined in registry (block deploys), 3) revert pipeline change.

 deploy-bot: scan-results: staging/base-image:2026-07-12 failed checks: CIS(4), PROV(2). See https://ci.internal/scans/1765439991

 sam: I'll own the rebuild runway. propose Thu 02:00-04:00 PT for canary, with rollback window 1hr.

 rachel: also add a postmortem checklist: ensure attest logs capture uid/gid for pulls and include cosign signature timestamp in audit record.

 ana: thanks all. I'll push the bake verify change and coordinate the sign-off with kevin. :thumbsup:
